```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  source(here::here("R", "load_data.R"))
))
```

```{r}
# Average land price by township/district
hsinchu <- list("j_lvr_land_a.csv", "o_lvr_land_a.csv") %>%
lapply(function(file) {

df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

# Promote first row to header
colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

# Select by name (more stable than column index)
df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
    "The villages and towns urban district",
    "main use",
    "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
  )))

}) %>%
bind_rows()

hsinchu <- hsinchu %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(TOWNNAME = `The villages and towns urban district`) %>%
  rename(LANDPRICE = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`)

hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu %>%
group_by(TOWNNAME) %>%
summarise(
avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
)

price_to_copy <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
filter(TOWNNAME == "新竹市") %>%
pull(avg_price) %>%
first()

if (length(price_to_copy) == 1 && !is.na(price_to_copy)) {
hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
add_row(
TOWNNAME = c("北區", "香山區", "東區"),
avg_price = price_to_copy
) %>%
filter(TOWNNAME != "新竹市")
}

hsinchu_ave_price
```

```{r}
hsinchu_pop_data <- aging_data %>%
filter(COUNTY %in% c("新竹縣", "新竹市")) %>%
select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
mutate(
A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT))
) %>%
rename(TOWNNAME = TOWN)

hsinchu_pop_data
```

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
```

```{r}
df_med <- bind_rows(
medical_data$medical_center %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "醫學中心"),
medical_data$hospital_regional %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "區域醫院"),
medical_data$hospital_local %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "地區醫院"),
medical_data$clinic %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "診所"),
medical_data$pharmacy %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "藥局")
)
```

```{r}
medical_summary <- df_med %>%
mutate(
地址 = iconv(地址, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = ""),
地址 = str_replace_all(地址, "台", "臺"),
Region = str_extract(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
Address_Clean = str_remove(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
District = str_extract(Address_Clean, "^.+?[區鄉鎮市]"),
Weight = case_when(
Level == "醫學中心" ~ 10,
Level == "區域醫院" ~ 5,
Level == "地區醫院" ~ 3,
Level == "診所" ~ 1,
Level == "藥局" ~ 0.5,
TRUE ~ 0
)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(Region), !is.na(District)) %>%
group_by(Region, District) %>%
summarise(
Medical_Score = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
Facility_Count = n(),
.groups = "drop"
)

medical_hsinchu <- medical_summary %>%
filter(Region %in% c("新竹市", "新竹縣"))
```

```{r}
land_hsinchu <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
mutate(
District = TOWNNAME,
Region = if_else(District %in% c("北區", "香山區", "東區"), "新竹市", "新竹縣")
) %>%
select(Region, District, avg_price)
```

```{r}
aging_hsinchu <- hsinchu_pop_data %>%
mutate(
Region = COUNTY,
District = TOWNNAME
) %>%
select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)
```

```{r}
medical_hsinchu <- medical_hsinchu %>%
select(Region, District, Medical_Score, Facility_Count)
```

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- aging_hsinchu %>%
inner_join(land_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
left_join(medical_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
mutate(
Medical_Score = replace_na(Medical_Score, 0),
Facility_Count = replace_na(Facility_Count, 0)
)

hsinchu_core
```

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- hsinchu_core %>%
mutate(
avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
Log_Price = log(avg_price),
Log_Medical = log(Medical_Score + 1),
Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
) %>%
filter(
is.finite(Log_Price),
is.finite(Log_Medical),
!is.na(Aging_Burden)
)
```

```{r}
# Add this once (near your other libraries)
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(
  hsinchu_core,
  aes(x = Aging_Burden, y = Log_Medical, size = Log_Price)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District),      # labels per dot
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Housing Price (log)") +
  labs(
    title = "Inverse Care Law in Hsinchu: Aging, Housing Prices, and Medical Resources",
    x = "Aging Burden (Elderly Dependency Ratio)",
    y = "Medical Resource Availability (log score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Quadrant scatter with township labels
# (Uses ggrepel to avoid overlapping text)

library(ggrepel)

hsinchu_quadrant <- hsinchu_core %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Price_Tier = dplyr::ntile(avg_price, 3),
    Price_Tier = factor(
      Price_Tier,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Low price", "Mid price", "High price")
    ),
    Town_Label = District
  )

x_cut <- stats::median(hsinchu_quadrant$Aging_Burden, na.rm = TRUE)
y_cut <- stats::median(hsinchu_quadrant$Medical_Score, na.rm = TRUE)

hsinchu_quadrant <- hsinchu_quadrant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Need_Level = dplyr::if_else(Aging_Burden >= x_cut, "High need", "Low need"),
    Care_Level = dplyr::if_else(Medical_Score >= y_cut, "High care", "Low care"),
    Quadrant   = paste(Need_Level, Care_Level, sep = " / ")
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  hsinchu_quadrant,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = Aging_Burden,
    y = Medical_Score,
    color = Price_Tier,
    shape = Price_Tier
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = x_cut, linetype = "dotted") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = y_cut, linetype = "dotted") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    ggplot2::aes(label = Town_Label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Validating the Inverse Care Law: Need vs Care with Housing Price Tier",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Quadrant cutoffs use medians: need = ", round(x_cut, 2),
      ", care = ", round(y_cut, 2)
    ),
    x = "Need: Elderly Dependency Ratio (Aging Burden)",
    y = "Care: Medical Resource Density (Medical Score)",
    color = "Housing price tier",
    shape = "Housing price tier"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# =========================
# English translation for labels in BOTH scatter plots (Hsinchu)
# Add this block BEFORE the two ggplot() calls (so District labels become English)
# =========================

# Region + district/township English lookup
region_en <- c(
  "新竹市" = "Hsinchu City",
  "新竹縣" = "Hsinchu County"
)

district_en <- c(
  # Hsinchu City districts
  "東區"   = "East District",
  "北區"   = "North District",
  "香山區" = "Xiangshan District",

  # Hsinchu County townships/cities
  "竹北市" = "Zhubei City",
  "竹東鎮" = "Zhudong Township",
  "新埔鎮" = "Xinpu Township",
  "關西鎮" = "Guanxi Township",
  "湖口鄉" = "Hukou Township",
  "新豐鄉" = "Xinfeng Township",
  "芎林鄉" = "Qionglin Township",
  "寶山鄉" = "Baoshan Township",
  "北埔鄉" = "Beipu Township",
  "峨眉鄉" = "Emei Township",
  "橫山鄉" = "Hengshan Township",
  "尖石鄉" = "Jianshi Township",
  "五峰鄉" = "Wufeng Township"
)

# Create English label columns (fallback to Chinese if not found)
hsinchu_core_en <- hsinchu_core %>%
  mutate(
    Region_EN   = dplyr::recode(Region,   !!!region_en,   .default = as.character(Region)),
    District_EN = dplyr::recode(District, !!!district_en, .default = as.character(District))
  )

# =========================

  labs(
    title = "Inverse Care Law in Hsinchu: Aging, Housing Prices, and Medical Resources",
    x = "Aging Burden (Elderly Dependency Ratio)",
    y = "Medical Resource Availability (log score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# =========================
# Scatter 2: Quadrant plot WITH English labels
# =========================
hsinchu_quadrant_en <- hsinchu_core_en %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Price_Tier = factor(
      Price_Tier,

x_cut <- stats::median(hsinchu_quadrant_en$Aging_Burden, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
med_ref <- mean(hsinchu_core_en$Log_Medical, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(
  hsinchu_core_en,
  aes(x = Aging_Burden, y = Log_Medical, size = Log_Price)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  # Linear regression WITH shaded confidence band
  geom_smooth(
    aes(size = NULL),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_ref, linetype = "dotted") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District_EN),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Housing Price (log)") +
  labs(
    title = "Inverse Care Law in Hsinchu: Aging, Housing Prices, and Medical Resources",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Dashed = LM trend with 95% CI band; Mean medical availability (log) = ",
      round(med_ref, 2)
    ),
    x = "Aging Burden (Elderly Dependency Ratio)",
    y = "Medical Resource Availability (log score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
